rationale: The Latin anchors *excogitare* ("to think out, devise mentally") and *invenire* ("to find, discover") both point firmly to the sense of arriving at something through mental effort, matching synset invent.v.01. The attestations from Exeter Book and Genesis contexts further support a cognitive/intellectual meaning ("to think out, conceive"), rather than legal bequest (devise.v.03) or logistical planning (organize.v.05).
